The impulse appears more adverse for ETH than BTC: ETH underperformed BTC in the reported 12h and 24h windows, ETH/BTC fell over all supplied sequence windows, and ETH open interest rose while ETH price declined between captures.

The conflict is temporally ordered rather than purely contradictory: the latest snapshot and shorter reported window are weak, while the longer reported BTC windows retain gains. On supplied evidence, this is consistent with a reversal or retracement after prior strength, not sufficient evidence of a sustained multi-day downtrend.

The disagreement is material and unresolved; this is a shadow conflict interpretation only.
